|---|---|---|
| `bmad-method/` | BMad Method v6.12.1, plus the v6.10.0 tech writer: https://github.com/bmad-code-org/BMAD-METHOD | MIT, with BMad Code, LLC's trademark notice |
| `arc-studio-cli/` | `@circle-fin/arc-studio-cli` 1.1.3: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@circle-fin/arc-studio-cli | MIT |

Content that we only link to or fetch at install time, such as Circle's skills (Apache-2.0), is not copied here. See section 2 of the notices file.
